registration.title: Become a Volunteer Helper
registration.description: Join our community of compassionate listeners and make a difference in someone's life.

legal.title: Volunteer Guidelines & Disclaimer
legal.subtitle: Please read carefully before proceeding.
legal.agreement: I have read and agree to the volunteer guidelines and terms of service.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines for Helpers
guidelines.intro: As a volunteer, you play a crucial role in maintaining a safe and supportive environment.
guidelines.point1: Offer support and active listening, not professional therapy.
guidelines.point2: Respect user confidentiality and privacy at all times.
guidelines.point3: Never provide medical advice, diagnosis, or medication recommendations.
guidelines.point4: Refer seekers to professional crisis resources if they are in danger.
guidelines.point5: Maintain appropriate boundaries; do not share personal contact info outside the platform.
guidelines.point6: Act with empathy, respect, and non-judgment towards all users.

important.title: Important Notice
important.message: You are volunteering as a peer supporter. You are NOT acting as a licensed mental health professional on this platform.

platform.title: What Nidal-Alrouh Provides:
platform.point1: A connection to people seeking support.
platform.point2: Tools to schedule and manage sessions.

notPlatform.title: What We Are NOT:
notPlatform.point1: We are NOT a healthcare provider.
notPlatform.point2: We are NOT liable for interactions between users.

bio.label: About You
bio.placeholder: Share a bit about yourself, why you want to help, and your experience with mental health support...

specializations.label: Areas of Support
specializations.description: Select topics you feel comfortable discussing.
specializations.error: Please select at least one specialization.

languages.label: Languages
languages.error: Please select at least one language.

maxSessions.label: Max Sessions Per Week
maxSessions.description: How many 30-minute sessions can you handle per week?

cal.title: Cal.com Integration
cal.subtitle: Connect your calendar for seamless scheduling.
cal.explanation: We use Cal.com to handle bookings and Google Meet links. This keeps your personal calendar private while allowing seekers to book times you're available.

steps.2: Set up your availability and connect your Google Calendar.

username.label: Cal.com Username
username.hint: Enter only your username (e.g., 'sarah-jones'), not the full URL.

preview.title: Booking Link Preview
preview.note: This is where seekers will go to book sessions with you.
